UrbanLens Studio 16 building realism assets
==========================================
Photos retain their listed licenses. Changes: JPEG resizing/compression; runtime planar UV cropping and perspective correction. CC BY-SA photo adaptations are offered under the same respective license. Geometry is illustrative, not a measured or photogrammetric model.

Author: Rob Tuytel
License: CC0-1.0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/grey_roof_tiles
